# Definition of Done — COpenClaw

*Auto-generated by Foundry migration on 2026-03-15*

## Quality Gates

Each criterion must be satisfied before work is considered complete.

1. [x] All existing tests pass with zero failures
2. [ ] New functionality includes corresponding test coverage
3. [ ] CI pipeline exists and passes
4. [ ] Application starts successfully without errors

## Python Standards

1. [ ] Type hints on all public functions
2. [ ] Linting passes (flake8/ruff) with zero errors
3. [ ] Code formatted with black or ruff format

## Deployment Readiness

1. [ ] Deployment method documented (Docker, cloud platform, or other)
2. [x] Environment configuration template exists (.env.example)
3. [ ] All required environment variables documented

## Documentation Requirements

1. [x] README.md exists with project description
2. [x] Setup / installation instructions included in README
3. [ ] Usage examples documented
4. [ ] No critical or high-severity bugs remain open

## Stretch Goals (Infrastructure Gaps)

These are not required for "done" but represent improvements to project maturity.

1. [ ] Set up CI/CD pipeline (e.g., GitHub Actions)
2. [ ] Add Docker configuration for reproducible builds
3. [ ] Declare all dependencies in a package manifest
4. [ ] Add a docs/ directory with architecture and usage guides
